resumeText: Zara Ali is a RAG Engineer at Nova Retrieval with three years of experience. She builds retrieval-augmented generation pipelines over vector databases using LangChain, and uses Elasticsearch for hybrid and keyword retrieval. She spent two years as a backend engineer at Sandstone Payments before moving into RAG work. Her strengths are pipeline engineering and vector indexing; her NLP and dedicated embeddings experience is still maturing.
